==English== ===Alternative forms=== * {{alt|en|scituation||hypercorrect|obsolete}} ===Etymology=== From {{inh|en|enm|situacioun}}, {{m|enm|situacion}}, from {{der|en|frm|situation}}, from {{der|en|la-med|situatio||position, situation}}, from {{m|la|situare||to locate, place}}, from {{uder|en|la|situs||a site}}. {{surf|+suf|en|situate|-ion}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{enPR|sĭt-yo͞o-ā'shən|a=RP,GA}}, {{IPA|en|/ˌsɪt.juːˈeɪ.ʃən/|[ˌsɪt.juːˈeɪ.ʃn̩]|/ˌsɪt.juˈeɪ.ʃən/|[ˌsɪt.juˈeɪ.ʃn̩]}} * {{enPR|sĭch-o͞o-ā'shən|a=GA,CA}}, {{IPA|en|/ˌsɪ.t͡ʃuˈ(w)eɪ.ʃən/|[ˌsɪ.t͡ʃuˈeɪ.ʃn̩]}} * {{IPA|en|/ˌsɪt͡ʃʉwˈɛjʃ(ə)n/|/ˌsɪtjʉwˈɛjʃ(ə)n/|a=SSB}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-situation.ogg|a=US}} * {{IPA|en|/ˌsɪt.jʉːˈæɪ.ʃən/|[ˌsɪt.jʉːˈæɪ.ʃn̩]|a=AU}} * {{IPA|en|/ˌsət.jʉːˈæɪ.ʃən/|[ˌsət.jʉːˈæɪ.ʃn̩]|a=NZ}} * {{IPA|en|/sɪ.tʃʊˈʋe.ʃən/|/sɪ.ʈ(j)ʊˈʋe.ʃən/|a=Indic}} * {{rhymes|en|eɪʃən|s=4}} ===Noun=== {{en-noun|situations|situatia}} # The [[combination]] of [[circumstance]]s at a given moment; a [[state of affairs]]. #: {{ux|en|The United States is in an awkward '''situation''' with debt default looming.}} #* {{RQ:Churchill Celebrity|chapter=5|passage=Then we relapsed into a discomfited silence, and wished we were anywhere else. But Miss Thorn relieved the '''situation''' by laughing aloud, and with such a hearty enjoyment that instead of getting angry and more mortified we began to laugh ourselves, and instantly felt better.}} #* {{RQ:Time|title=The Danger of Surrendering Your Financial Independence in a Relationship|date=April 22 2026|author=Jillian Sanders |text=By 29, my financial '''situation''' wasn’t just disorganized, it was untenable. I didn’t have enough money to cover a single unexpected expense, and my credit card balance wasn’t going down; the interest was outpacing me. |url=https://time.com/article/2026/04/17/the-danger-of-surrendering-your-financial-independence-in-a-relationship/ |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260422181713/https://time.com/article/2026/04/17/the-danger-of-surrendering-your-financial-independence-in-a-relationship/}} # {{senseid|en|vis-a-vis surroundings}}The way in which something is [[position#Verb|positioned]] [[vis-à-vis]] its [[surroundings]]. #: {{ux|en|The Botanical Gardens are in a delightful '''situation''' on the river bank.}} #* {{RQ:Grahame Wind in the Willows|passage={{...}}he being naturally an underground animal by birth and breeding, the '''situation''' of Badger's house exactly suited him and made him feel at home; while the Rat, who slept every night in a bedroom the windows of which opened on a breezy river, naturally felt the atmosphere still and oppressive.}} # The place in which something is [[situated]]; a [[location]]. #* {{quote-book|en|year=1801|author=Timothy Alden|title=The Glory of America. A Century Sermon, Delivered at the South Church, in Portsmouth, Newhampshire ... Together with ... Historical Notes, and an Appendix, Containing an Account of Newspapers Printed in the State|page=37 |text={{...}} one of the most pleasant situations in America. With the exception of one melancholy season, no town in the union, of its size, has had a greater share of the inestimable blessing of health.}} #* {{quote-book|en|year=1833|author=Thomas Hibbert; Robert Buist|title=The American Flower Garden Directory|page=142 |passage=''[Hibíscus] speciòsus'' is the most splendid, and deserves a '''situation''' in every garden.}} #* {{quote-book|en|year=1848|author=Anne Brontë|title=The Tenant of Wildfell Hall|page=37 |text=I described the situation as well as I could, and was entering upon an explanation of the various roads, lanes, and fields to be traversed in order to reach it, the goings straight on, and turnings to the right, and the left{{nb...}}}} # Position or [[status]] with regard to [[condition]]s and [[circumstance]]s. # {{lb|en|UK}} A position of employment; a [[post]]. #* {{RQ:Dickens Christmas Carol|passage=‘Let me hear another sound from you,’ said Scrooge, ‘and you’ll keep your Christmas by losing your '''situation'''!}} #* {{RQ:Lawrence Sons and Lovers|[[s:Sons and Lovers/Chapter 3|Chapter 3]]|passage=When he was nineteen, he suddenly left the 'Co-op' office, and got a '''situation''' in Nottingham.}} #* {{quote-song|en|year=1946|author=Vaughn Horton; Denver Darling; Milt Gabler|title=w:Choo Choo Ch'Boogie |passage=You take a morning paper from the top of the stack
And read the '''situations''' from the front to the back
The only job that's open need a man with a knack
So put it right back in the rack Jack.}} # A difficult or unpleasant set of circumstances; a [[problem]]. #: {{syn|en|Thesaurus:difficult situation}} #: {{ux|en|Boss, we've got a '''situation''' here…}} # {{lb|en|US|film industry}} An individual [[movie theater]]. #* {{quote-book|en|year=1950|author=United States. Congress. House. Committee on Ways and Means|title=Revenue Revision of 1950: Hearings Before the Committee|page=1805 |passage=This survey includes all key '''situations''' (including Paramount Gulf Theaters) as well as suburban runs and small-town '''situations'''.}} #* {{quote-journal|en|year=1960|journal=Motion Picture Herald|volume=218-219|page=14 |passage={{...}} Craterian theatre, with a full-scale advance campaign and preliminary screenings held for opinion-makers. Results and reactions will be closely studied and, if popular, the idea will be extended to other '''situations'''.}} # {{lb|en|slang}} An [[outfit]], [[garment]], or [[look]]. #: {{ux|en|She is
